about: The example pack of docs/first-pack.md: two small routines of ours at the first instructions of two functions of the firmware that the start-up calls once each, and one line in the log. Each routine goes on into the firmware's function through a trampoline the base makes in the pack's zeroed data. It needs no other pack and no pack needs it. tools/build_all.py builds it into out/examples/. It is no feature: it shows what a pack is made of.
name: trampolines
